title: weighted round robin: weight 1:2 dispatch ratio, no pool/command oversubscription, no starvation

fixed_configuration.why_P2: SCHEDULER: 1:2 is owed per complete feasible round (weight1 ready>=1, weight2 ready>=2). The P=1 ready window is 2P=2 and cannot hold 1+2 ready items, so a P=1 fixture measures availability, not weights. P=2 gives ready window 2P=4 and can hold the complete round.
fixed_configuration.measurement: dispatch start events (unit callable entry), not completions; readiness before each dispatch from submitted/started/completed counters
fixed_configuration.criterion: for every complete feasible round (start has weight1 ready>=1 and weight2 ready>=2) the three dispatches must be exactly {w1,w2,w2}; violations=0; complete_rounds>=100 per run; 5/5 quiet runs. No +/- ratio tolerance is used.

tolerance: per-round multiset {w1,w2,w2}: violations must be 0; complete rounds >= 100 per run; 5/5 runs. No ratio tolerance.
